station.use: Daily data used only to fix station coordinates; pair displacements remain the existing five-minute estimates.

formula: d_ENU = A*g + residual; g = (delta_E_source_to_station, delta_N_source_to_station, depth)/R; Ahat=(g.T C^-1 d)/(g.T C^-1 g). A units mm at BYRL, not reservoir volume/pressure.
covariance: C=diag(SE_E_master^2+SE_E_slave^2, SE_N_master^2+SE_N_slave^2, SE_U_master^2+SE_U_slave^2). Component and temporal covariances unavailable in the five-minute archive and not modeled.
physical_assumptions: Single isotropic Mogi point source, homogeneous elastic half-space, flat surface at the station reference level; depth relative to that plane; positive A is expansion conditional on this model.
independent_labels: Source center fixed from existing HRMM polygon; depth midpoint fixed before calculation; no PGV peaks, eruption timing or agreement scores used to fit source geometry.
